data.note: Use DEX (instead of STR) for attack and damage rolls of your Unarmed Strikes and Monk Weapons. Martial Arts die: 1d6 (L1), 1d8 (L5), 1d10 (L11), 1d12 (L17). When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make one Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action. Monk Weapons = Simple Melee weapons + Shortsword + any other weapon you choose with the Monk property. v0 surfaces the action-modifier override and bonus-action activity; the die scaling table isn't simulated beyond 1d6.

activities.name: Martial Arts: Unarmed Strike (Bonus)
activities.note: Immediately after the Attack action with an Unarmed Strike or Monk Weapon, make one Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action. Damage die uses the Martial Arts die (1d6 at L1, scaling later).

data.note: Focus Points pool: equal to your Monk level. Spent by various features (Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind, Stunning Strike, and subclass features). Recovers on a Short or Long Rest. v0 surfaces a single resource pool tagged per-short-rest; activities that spend focus reference this pool narratively.

activities.name: Step of the Wind
activities.note: Spend 1 Focus Point to take the Disengage or Dash action as a Bonus Action; jump distance is doubled for the turn. v0 doesn't deduct the focus point automatically — surface as a narrative note.

activities.name: Patient Defense
activities.note: Take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action (free), or spend 1 Focus Point to take both the Disengage and Dodge actions as a single Bonus Action. v0 doesn't deduct the focus point automatically.

activities.name: Flurry of Blows
activities.note: Immediately after the Attack action, spend 1 Focus Point to make two Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action (this activity models one of the two strikes; engine doesn't multi-target a single activity). Number of strikes increases to 3 at L10. v0 doesn't deduct the focus point automatically.

data.note: Placeholder for subclass selection (Warrior of the Open Hand, Shadow, Elements, Mercy in 2024). The chosen subclass slug lives on character.classes[].subclass.

When an attack roll hits you with a Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing attack (melee or ranged), use your Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + your DEX modifier + your Monk level. If the damage is reduced to 0, you can spend 1 Focus Point to redirect some of the attack's force: make a ranged attack with a thrown weapon or unarmed strike.
Player chooses +2/+1 distribution or a feat. v0 surfaces the choice; the chosen ASI is applied via stat-modifiers on the character document at edit time.

Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a Monk Weapon or Unarmed Strike, spend 1 Focus Point to force a CON saving throw against your Monk spell save DC (8 + PB + WIS). On a fail, the target has the Stunned condition until the end of your next turn. v0 doesn't deduct the focus point or enforce the once-per-turn cap automatically; surfaces as a tagged action-modifier toggle.
